name: Dino Market
summary: The molino grocery marketplace as a purple quick-delivery app: a violet bar with a delivery pill and a cart pill with the total, swipeable promo cards, the aisles as a tile grid, app cards with a round yellow + on the picture, an aisle column beside every listing, a rounded cart sheet with a free-shipping bar, a violet seller banner, and a friendly dinosaur on About, sign-in and the 404.
